name: Bloom Energy

eyebrow.en: Bloom Energy Corporation · Class A · San Jose, California
eyebrow.zh: Bloom Energy · A类股 · 加州圣何塞

title.zh: 为 AI 供电，现场发电。

lede.en: Bloom's solid oxide fuel cells let data centers make their own power instead of waiting years for a grid connection. Revenue hit a record $1.24B last quarter, up 138%, and 2026 guidance was raised a third time to $4.4–4.6B. Oracle, AEP and all major US hyperscalers are customers or have validated the product.
lede.zh: Bloom 的固体氧化物燃料电池让数据中心自行发电，无需等待多年接入电网。上季营收增 138% 至创纪录的 12.4 亿美元，2026 年指引第三次上调至 44–46 亿。甲骨文、AEP 及所有美国主要云厂商均为客户或已完成验证。

s.zh: 2027 年一致预期每股约 $4.63（非GAAP）· 约为 FY26 指引的 67 倍
营收，中值增 122% · 隐含第四季约 13.5–15.5 亿

s.en: Q4 2026 and 2027 outlook · date not yet announced
s.zh: 2026 第四季及 2027 年展望 · 日期未公布

sub_price.en: Daily closes with the 50-day average. The stock ranged from about $76 to $351 over the past year, with a beta near 3.8.
sub_price.zh: 每日收盘价与50日均线。过去一年股价在约 $76 至 $351 间，贝塔值近 3.8。

sub_rev.en: Revenue in US$ millions, with GAAP gross margin on the right axis. Bloom's revenue is lumpy and Q4-heavy because it is booked as systems are installed. The last bar is the Q4 revenue implied by the midpoint of the full-year guide.
sub_rev.zh: 营收单位为百万美元，右轴为 GAAP 毛利率。Bloom 按系统安装确认收入，因此季度波动大、第四季偏高。最后一根柱为全年指引中值所隐含的第四季营收。

s.zh: 同比 +138% · 创纪录，预期约 10.7 亿
同比 +179% · 首个产品收入破 10 亿的季度
非GAAP · 同比 +4 点 · 营业利润率 23%

p.en: Oracle powered a Utah site in under two months and AEP is deploying 700 MW for Google. Backlog is growing faster than revenue, and capacity is nearing 5 GW a year with more room in Fremont.
p.zh: 甲骨文犹他州站点不到两个月即完成供电，AEP 正为谷歌部署 700 兆瓦。订单储备增速快于营收，年产能接近 5 吉瓦，弗里蒙特仍有扩产空间。

p.en: Non-GAAP operating income was $286M in Q3, more than all of 2025; full-year guidance is now $960M–1.03B with EPS of $3.10–3.40.
p.zh: 第三季非GAAP营业利润 2.86 亿美元，超过 2025 年全年；全年指引上调至 9.6–10.3 亿，每股 $3.10–3.40。

p.en: Free cash flow was −$181M in Q3 as unbilled contract assets doubled to $859M and capex tripled to $153M. Margin guidance stayed at ~34% despite the revenue raise, on ramp and expediting costs.
p.zh: 第三季未开票合同资产翻倍至 8.59 亿美元、资本开支增至三倍的 1.53 亿，自由现金流为 −1.81 亿。尽管上调营收指引，因扩产和加急交付成本，毛利率指引仍维持约 34%。

p.en: About 47× next year's consensus earnings with a beta near 3.8; shares fell 8.7% on report day and further after hours despite the beat.
p.zh: 约为明年一致预期盈利的 47 倍，贝塔值近 3.8；财报当天股价跌 8.7%，业绩超预期后盘后继续下跌。
指引：营收 44–46 亿美元，非GAAP每股 $3.10–3.40。

h.zh: 第四季及 FY26 业绩

p.en: Expected to include 2027 guidance; date not yet announced.
p.zh: 预计给出 2027 年指引；日期未公布。

sources: Price, market cap and forward EPS: Stocklake, as of Oct 22, 2026

foot.en: Fundamentals as of Oct 22, 2026 (Q3 2026 results). For information only, not investment advice. Not affiliated with Bloom Energy Corporation.
foot.zh: 基本面数据截至 2026年10月22日（2026 年第三季业绩）。仅供参考，不构成投资建议。与 Bloom Energy Corporation 无关联。

guide: Dec 2026 · implied by FY guide midpoint
2026年12月 · 全年指引中值隐含

sub.en: Free cash flow is operating cash flow minus capital spending, in US$ millions, for the 20 quarters from Q4 2021 to Q3 2026. Shaded bars and italic rows are estimates.
sub.zh: 自由现金流 = 经营现金流 − 资本开支，单位百万美元，涵盖 2021 年第四季至 2026 年第三季共 20 个季度。浅色柱与斜体行为估算。

read.en: Bloom's cash flow follows its install schedule: it usually burns cash early in the year and collects in the fourth quarter. Q3 2026 turned negative (−$181M) as unbilled contract assets doubled to $859M, inventory grew and capex tripled; year to date free cash flow is still +$42M.
read.zh: Bloom 的现金流随安装进度变化：通常年初烧钱、第四季回款。2026 年第三季转负（−1.81 亿美元），因未开票合同资产翻倍至 8.59 亿、存货增加且资本开支增至三倍；年初至今自由现金流仍为 +4200 万。

read.en: The new guide implies $1.35–1.55B of Q4 revenue. I assume a strong Q4 collection as contract assets are billed, then a weak Q1, giving roughly $500M of free cash flow over four quarters. Capex runs higher, about $110–120M a quarter, as Bloom expands past 5 GW in Fremont and Newark.
read.zh: 新指引隐含第四季营收 13.5–15.5 亿美元。我假设合同资产开票后第四季回款强劲、第一季偏弱，四季自由现金流约 5 亿美元。随着 Bloom 在弗里蒙特和纽瓦克扩产至 5 吉瓦以上，资本开支提高至每季约 1.1–1.2 亿。

p.en: Contract assets, receivables and inventory used about $776M of cash in Q3, partly offset by $309M of customer deposits.
p.zh: 第三季合同资产、应收款和存货占用约 7.76 亿美元现金，部分被 3.09 亿客户预付款抵消。

p.en: Capex rose to $153M in Q3 and $231M year to date as capacity nears 5 GW.
p.zh: 随着产能接近 5 吉瓦，第三季资本开支升至 1.53 亿美元，年初至今 2.31 亿。

p.en: Product revenue of $1.07B in Q3, up 179%; net income of $249M.
p.zh: 第三季产品收入 10.7 亿美元，增 179%；净利润 2.49 亿。

p.en: Deferred revenue and deposits reached $754M, five times the December level.
p.zh: 递延收入及客户预付款达 7.54 亿美元，为去年 12 月的五倍。

extraNote.en: EPS is not shown in the revenue table because quarterly diluted EPS was not available from the data source.
extraNote.zh: 营收表未显示每股收益，因数据源未提供季度摊薄每股收益。
